description: Next.js 15 dynamic App Router parameters are promises and must be typed and consumed asynchronously.

fingerprint.errorSignature: Type '{ params: { slug: string; }; }' does not satisfy the constraint 'PageProps'.
fingerprint.regex: Type error:[\s\S]*params[\s\S]*(?:does not satisfy the constraint ['"]PageProps['"]|missing the following properties from type ['"]Promise)

doNot: Do not keep params typed as a synchronous object in an App Router page.
Do not merely mark the component async while retaining the old params type.
Do not cast params through unknown or any to suppress the generated PageProps contract.
Do not downgrade Next.js to retain synchronous request APIs.

mutations.description: Marks the page async but leaves params as the pre-v15 synchronous object type.
Changes the type to Promise but still reads slug synchronously instead of awaiting params.
